review.notes: Per-page text-layer comparison of all 41 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown (normalized), with rendered-page verification on physical pages 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 23 and 24 at 110-320 dpi. Dominant defect: the per-page footnote bodies (author asterisk/dagger notes and footnotes 1-19) were dropped while the inline superscript markers survived; each body was transcribed from a rendered bottom-strip crop and restored after the paragraph carrying its marker (patches group footnotes sharing one anchor line). The four Figure 2 template panel titles (Chat/Audio QA/Text-to-Speech/Text-to-Audio Templates) exist only inside the figure panels and were demoted from headings to plain text above their verbatim transcriptions. No code fences exist in the OCR markdown. Suspected drops of table rows (baseline model names, ablation rows) and prose fragments on pages 3-6, 10-18, 21-27 were confirmed present in the markdown HTML tables and paragraphs (line-reflow false positives); Table 1-13 values, appendix sections and references match the PDF text layer.
